text: Avoid this vacuum. Very little suction, ad said wAs good for sweeping up pet hair.  Nope it was unsatisfactory.  Not worth your time or money.

product_metadata.title: UMLo Cordless Vacuum Cleaner, N3 Blue
features: 【LARGE CAPACITY BATTERY & 40 MINS MAX RUNTIME】-This cordless vacuum cleaner comes with a 2200 mAh battery, providing up to 40 mins long lasting runtime on standard mode, and 20 mins on max mode. Long run-time cordless stick vacuum can help you clean the whole house for one charge. Battery indicator lights can show the battery level clearly

【ULTRA LIGHTWEIGHT & EXTENDABLE TUBE】The stick vacuum cleaner cordless only weighs 2.4 lbs, even a child can hold it easily. The extendable tube can be converted back and forth from 18.5 to 30.3 inches to vacuum ceilings, curtains, and high surfaces, meeting your floor-to-ceiling cleaning needs. This Lightweight vacuum makes it effortless and convenient for all family members to use

MULTIPLE ACCESSORIES & VERSATILE CLEANING】This wireless vacuum cleaners come with multiple accessories. Easy to assemble, 6-in-1 combinations to deep clean sofas, beds, cars, stairs, hard floors, and hardwood floors to meet your different cleaning needs, fit for home, dorm, apartment, etc. The vacuum cordless can be hung on the wall to save space

【HIGH-EFFICIENCY FILTRATION SYSTEM & WASHABLE HEPA】Vacuum cleaner features with 4-stage high-efficiency filtration system. This featherweight vacuum cordless collects up to 99.99% of microscopic fine particles as small as 0.1 microns and expels cleaner air into your home. The filter is washable. There are two additional filters that come with the hardwood floor vacuum as a backup. Regularly cleaning and replacing the filter can maintain the powerful suction

【POWERFUL SUCTION & 2 POWER MODES】The vacuum stick provides 12000Pa max powerful suction and 2 power modes to meet various cleaning demands. Easy to operate, just press the button to quickly pick up pet hair, crumbs, dust, debris, etc

【MANEUVERABLE BRUSH HEAD & NO-WORRY SERVICE】No roller design reduces the problem of hair tangling. Flexible 180° swivels sideways and 90°up and down, and the flat floor brush head design allows access under furniture and bed to clean up the dust that is hard to reach. Each N3 cordless pet vacuum comes with a 12-month satisfactory after-sales service. Ideal gift choice for your families and friends
